name: Substitute Breach Notice (Website Posting and Statewide Media)
description: When substitute notice applies (cost over $100,000, more than 175,000 affected, or insufficient contact information), the District emails affected individuals, posts the notice on its website, and notifies statewide media.
recipient: Affected individuals; public; major statewide media
quote: Substitute notice shall consist of an email notice, when the District has an email address for the individual; conspicuous posting of the notice on the District’s website; and notification to major statewide media.
